namingConvention.notes: Steps are multiples of 100 and never reused for a different value. Do not invent intermediate steps (e.g. space.450) without a design review; prefer the nearest existing step.

scale.name: space.100
scale.usage: hairline gaps, icon inset, chip padding

scale.name: space.200
scale.usage: tight intra-component spacing, toolbar button gaps

scale.name: space.300
scale.usage: dense list gutters, form field gaps

scale.name: space.400
scale.usage: default card padding, grid gap, section rhythm

scale.name: space.1600
scale.usage: hero outer margin, feature band spacing

notes: Never write raw px strings into components. Use var(--space-N) in CSS/SCSS and Tailwind utilities in JSX. If a requested value has no exact token, propose the nearest scale step to the user before creating a new token. New tokens require: (1) an entry here, (2) a matching CSS variable in styles/tokens.css, (3) a changelog line.
